entities.name: Multiplayer
entities.description: MW4's core 6v6 and larger-scale competitive modes.
tips: Six Core 6v6 maps ship at launch, each with a distinct identity and a custom infil.
Respawn modes: Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, Free-for-All, Counter Attack, Inflation, Hijack.
Round-based: Search & Destroy, Gunfight and Gunfight 10v10.
Ground War: Combat Outpost plus other large-scale modes.
Party modes: Gun Game and Drop Zone.
Every mode has a Hardcore variant - limited HUD, friendly fire, reduced health and no regeneration.

entities.name: Warzone
entities.description: The free-to-play battle royale. Zombies were removed in Season 1 of MW4 and the map is now Verdansk-style rotation.
tips: Season 1 added Zodiac - a new Resurgence map built by Beenox.
The DMZ map Hajin also arrives in Battle Royale as a Warzone map.
Resurgence brings eliminated players back fast - play aggressively early.
Contract objectives (Bounty, Scavenger, Upload Intel) pay out and mark your position - take them when you are grouped.
Keep a gas mask for the endgame gas - or plan to rotate away before it closes.

entities.name: DMZ
entities.description: The extraction mode on the Hajin map. Deploy solo or with a squad, recover tech, extract.
tips: Every deployment is a new run - loot, fight, negotiate, betray, extract.
You lose everything you carry if you die and fail to extract.
The exclusion zone shifts - weather, dynamic objectives and hostile forces change.
Keys open locked rooms and safes; the intel you carry is the objective.
Squad up - the extraction points are safer with a team covering each other.

entities.name: Campaign
entities.description: The single-player story. Price is on the run, conflict on the Korean Peninsula, a weapon of war about to fall into the wrong hands.
tips: Follow Price through the campaign - the story is about the weapon and who controls it.
Modern Warfare 4 campaign is built for replay - collectibles and intel rewards.
Play on a difficulty where you can learn the mechanics before the story stakes pile up.
The campaign and multiplayer share weapons, so the two reinforce each other.

entities.name: Classes
tips: A class is a primary weapon, a secondary, lethal, tactical, perk and field upgrade.
In Warzone use the 6-slot build - one primary, one secondary, two lethal, one tactical and a field upgrade.
Keep the perks that match your range: overkill and fast hands for close, commando and scavenger for mid.
Field upgrades are the most important choice - tendril, shock mine and thermite change how a fight is won.
Do not over-invest in one class - swap for the situation.

entities.name: Maps
entities.description: The 20 launch maps across three scales.
tips: Core 6v6: Cachette, Coal, Lithium, Lotus, Mumbai, Munition, Nautical, Reactor U92, Rooftops, Sentry, Silkworm, Transit 213.
Ground War 32v32: Imjin Farmland, Wolves Stadium, Forest.
Gunfight 2v2: Cafe, Library, NYC, Smuggler.
Kill Block is a modular live-fire training facility that reconfigures before every match - supports 3v3 and 10v10 Gunfight at launch.
Every map has its own infil and sightlines - learn the spawn side first.

entities.name: Weapons
entities.description: 33 weapons at launch, split into assault rifles, SMGs, shotguns, LMGs, sniper rifles and shotguns.
tips: The gun you pick decides your range - do not carry a shotgun into a long fight.
Full-auto is forgiving; if the gun has a burst mode, learn it.
Recoil control matters more than the gun - the same rifle kills with the same pattern.
LMGs trade mobility for sustained fire - they dominate long sightlines.
Aim assist on controller is strong at close range - use it and stop fighting it.

entities.name: Settings
entities.description: Best controller and PC settings for MW4.
tips: Set your aim assist to the default - the game is tuned for it.
Use the largest field of view that still shows enemies comfortably.
Lower the aim assist strength if you overshoot on aim.
On PC, prioritise mouse sensitivity and raw input over graphics settings.
Turn off motion blur and film grain - they hide enemies at range.
